# Paste-ready itch.io copy for 0.19.7-beta1

Use the text below on the Projekt Kraken itch page when the verified
0.19.7-beta1 ZIP and checksum replace the 0.19.6-beta1 downloads. Keep the
existing feature description if desired.

## Download and install

ProjektKraken 0.19.7 beta 1 is a Windows x64 beta. Download both
`ProjektKraken-0.19.7-beta1-windows-x64.zip` and
`ProjektKraken-0.19.7-beta1-windows-x64.zip.sha256`. In PowerShell, run
`Get-FileHash .\ProjektKraken-0.19.7-beta1-windows-x64.zip -Algorithm SHA256`
and compare the result with the value in the checksum file.

Extract the entire ZIP to a normal user folder. Open the extracted
`ProjektKraken` folder and run `ProjektKraken.exe`. Keep its `_internal`
folder beside the executable. Python is not required. The app is unsigned,
so Windows may ask you to confirm that you want to run it.

When updating, back up your existing `worlds` folder and install the whole
new application folder. Replacing only `ProjektKraken.exe` is insufficient.
Keep your world folders intact during the update.

## Known limitations

- The packaged beta is for Windows x64.
- Rich wiki editing covers paragraphs, headings 1–3, bold, italic, and wiki
  links. Other Markdown remains editable in exact Source view.
- Wiki Peek currently displays text descriptions, without rich media previews.
- Dated map path and region shapes switch at the authored date; shapes do not
  morph between states.

Report issues with your Windows version, package version, and reproduction
steps.

## Short demo opening

Start on a populated map with the timeline visible. Move the playhead across
an authored date and show the resulting map change immediately. Then show
the related event and the older state by moving the playhead back. Keep setup
and menu navigation after this opening sequence.
